apps.name: WhatsApp
apps.label: WhatsApp
apps.description: Your chats in a little panel. Scan the QR code once with your phone and it stays logged in.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.label: Spotify
apps.description: Spotify's player in a panel. The button shows what's playing; middle-click to play or pause. Right-click → Player mode for just the little floating player.

apps.name: Instagram
apps.label: Instagram
apps.description: Reels in a little panel, with sound. Use ↑ ↓ to move between reels, Space to pause, M to mute. Log in once and it stays logged in.

apps.name: Reolink Camera
apps.label: Doorbell
apps.description: A quick peek at a Reolink camera or doorbell on your home network. Log in once and it stays logged in. Right-click its button for the full camera controls.

menu.label: Show / hide camera controls

apps.name: Calendar
apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: Your upcoming events, read-only. Sign in with Google or Microsoft, connect iCloud, or paste any shared calendar link. Add as many as you like, star the one that should open first, or see them all together.

title.labelOption: Show today's next event on the button

google.name: Google Calendar
steps: Sign in with your Google account.
On the left, under “Settings for my calendars”, click the calendar you want.
Scroll down to “Integrate calendar” and click the eye next to “Secret address in iCal format”.

outlook.name: Outlook
steps: Sign in with your Microsoft account.
Under “Publish a calendar”, pick your calendar and “Can view all details”, then click Publish.
If it was already published, the links show straight away.

icloud.name: iCloud Calendar
steps: Sign in with your Apple Account (you may need to approve it on your iPhone).
In the list of calendars, click the share icon next to the one you want.
Tick “Public Calendar”. Only people with the link can see it.

apps.page:
Today

Calendars

The starred calendar is the one that opens first.

apps.name: Hue Lights
apps.label: Hue
apps.description: Control your Philips Hue lights from the taskbar. Opens on your favourite room or zone, and every room, zone, scene and light is one click away. Connects straight to your Hue Bridge at home; no account needed.

title.labelOption: Show your favourite room's lights on the button

apps.page:
Lights

Star a room to open it here every time

Hue Bridge

apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.label: Home
apps.description: Your own Home Assistant dashboard, one click from the taskbar. Design it in Home Assistant with any cards you like (lights, cameras, bins, heating), then pick it here. Signs in with your normal Home Assistant login.

setup.label: Your Home Assistant address, e.g. homeassistant.local:8123 or your Nabu Casa address
Dashboard to open (optional): the end of its address, e.g. dashboard-mini. Leave empty for your main one.
Show Home Assistant's top bar (off: your dashboard fills the whole panel)

menu.label: Show / hide the Home Assistant menu

apps.name: Clipboard
apps.label: Clipboard
apps.description: Everything you've copied lately, text, links and pictures, one click from the taskbar. Click one to copy it again, search, and pin the bits you paste all the time. Kept on this PC only, encrypted, and passwords from password managers are never saved.

apps.name: Weather
apps.label: Weather
apps.description: The weather where you are, right on the taskbar button (e.g. 14° Cloudy). Open it for the next 24 hours and the week ahead. Search any town or city, °C or °F. Free forecasts from Open-Meteo; no account needed.

title.labelOption: Show the temperature on the button

apps.name: Notes
apps.label: Notes
apps.description: A quick scratchpad and a to-do list, one click from the taskbar. Saves as you type, and the button shows how many to-dos are left. Kept on this PC only.

title.labelOption: Show how many to-dos are left on the button

apps.name: Timer
apps.label: Timer
apps.description: A countdown on your taskbar. One click for 5, 10, 25 or 45 minutes, or type your own. The button counts down as you work, and it beeps and pops up when time's up.

title.labelOption: Show the countdown on the button

apps.page:

apps.name: Converter
apps.label: Converter
apps.description: Currencies (live rates, 160 of them) and everyday units: length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, data and time. Type it the way you'd say it, like "50 usd to gbp" or "6 ft in cm". Pin a rate to show it on the button.

title.labelOption: Show the pinned rate on the button

apps.page: Also

apps.name: Battery
apps.label: Battery
apps.description: Battery levels in one place: this laptop, connected Bluetooth headphones and speakers, and Logitech mice and keyboards on a receiver. The button can show whichever is lowest, so you charge things before they die.

title.labelOption: Show the lowest battery on the button

apps.name: Parcels
apps.label: Parcels
apps.description: Paste a tracking number or link and it works out the courier (Royal Mail, Evri, DPD, Yodel, UPS, DHL, FedEx, Amazon and more). It checks in the background and the button tells you when something's out for delivery.
